title: Verify the Fix: Security Regression Suite
objective: Build a single-command security regression suite that guards the controls from term 1 and CSRF, and prove at least two tests fail when their corresponding fix is reverted.
whyThisMatters: A fix without a test that can go red is a story. This path's motto is learn by doing; the suite is how a mentor — and your future self — re-checks that authorization, injection, encoding and CSRF controls still hold.
evidence: A test-inventory table listing each test, the threat-model id or OWASP category it guards, and the command that runs the suite
Git history showing the suite grown across multiple commits, not added in one dump
Command output of the full suite passing, with a timestamp
Command output of at least 2 named tests failing after their fix is reverted, then passing after restore
Reflection note answering the task questions
acceptanceCriteria: The suite contains at least 8 tests covering at least 4 of: authentication, authorization, injection, XSS, CSRF, secrets-not-in-response.
Each test file or test name references a threat-model threat id or an OWASP category.
At least 2 tests are shown failing when their corresponding fix is reverted, then passing when the fix is restored; commands and outputs are recorded.
The full suite runs to completion with a single documented command.
